basis: Initial twelve-task screen improves 7/12 to 10/12, no lost passing task or critical write.
rules: Same frozen workers, settings, twelve-task confirmation corpus and six-task validation corpus.
Two further repetitions in both arms and one validation comparison. All four jobs are admitted together in the final supervised 180-second batch; comparisons remain sequential.
The existing 3600-second execution cap and 60-second turn/120-second case limits remain unchanged. A deadline leaves explicit incomplete evidence and prevents promotion.
Validation is collected without intermediate tuning; it cannot override a failed repetition or critical outcome.
